Bring your students to Barcelona

Education programmes for secondary, high-school and VET groups, built around your dates, your subject and the size of the group. Programmes can run in English or Spanish, with the accompanying teachers involved throughout the week.

Plan your group Hola@SpainBcn.com

How a group programme comes together

Define the objectives

Tell us what you want students to work on during the programme, and the dates you are looking at.

We build the programme

Classes, trainers, venue and cultural activities. A private programme or a group project is quoted for the group: tell us the group and we confirm the fee and the invoicing in writing before you commit.

The group comes to Barcelona

We run the agreed programme, and provide the agreed documentation afterwards.

Plan your group

Pick what you already know. Your answers travel with you to the enquiry, so you only say this once.

What we can organise

  • Scheduled course weeks your staff join
  • Private course weeks for one institution
  • Tailored training, with subject areas combined
  • Programmes for student groups
  • Job shadowing placements
  • Educational visits

If your project needs something this page does not name, ask us.

Practical points

  • Accompanying teachers stay with the group through the week.
  • Two afternoons are given to the week's cultural activities. Both are included in the fee, both are optional, and someone from the team goes with the group.
  • Travel, accommodation and meals are arranged by your school and are not part of the fee.
  • Certificate of attendance for participants, issued on the final day.

Tell us about the group

The group, the subject and the dates you have in mind are enough to start. A real person replies within two working days, usually sooner.
